title: Building audit review, recipient decisions, native energy analysis and complete editable turnover

task.name: Commission the selected building-audit operation and deliver an independently usable engineering workspace
task.purpose: Give the named customer an inspectable connection from original building-audit XML and observed weather to reviewed source corrections, exact native energy results and an editable turnover package. Continue the original commercial case and its useful customer task through the installed Audit, Applications, Merchant and receiving interfaces. Give colleagues the complete original source to review offline, accept deliberate returns through the installed author, work ordered returns and explicitly reassess earlier findings after source corrections.
task.request: Select the actual customer building portfolio, original audit source edition, source-use authority, engineering scope and receiving operator. Retain the complete BuildingSync XML before selecting its schema and official profiles. Inspect native facilities, buildings, systems, resources, scenarios, fields, relationships and every original reading. Correct selected source fields deliberately with their original expected values; retain all source revisions and actual validation outcomes. Record source-bound engineering reviews and explicit downstream links, then save the selected edition. Where energy analysis is included, choose one exact building/scenario/resource/Total-energy stream and complete acquired weather with actual units, interval, timezone and station basis. Run the selected original nmecr models, retaining applicability, convergence, statistics, predictions and full native outputs. Preview and save the complete eight-table turnover selection. Export the complete project and its selected installed application, independently receive and reopen it, then carry the same source into any separately selected LDA Search/Brief or asset receiving workflow. Where the agreed work includes a colleague return, send the complete editable project, receive its complete returned ZIP, compare proven original/current/returned revisions and deliberately review conflicts and returned source reviews. Validate and apply the full selected plan together through the original request, retaining the returned archive and resulting saved edition. Where recipient review is commissioned, prepare the whole recipient editor from an actual retained export; preserve every manuscript edition and original source byte. Stage its complete return in the original author, read the full current preview and deliberately accept proposals through original native review requests. Save ordered queue editions with actual Review/Defer choices and per-return notes; acceptance stays a separate operation. After a source revision, inspect each earlier finding against complete earlier/current native material and validation, then explicitly retain it or supply a complete reviewed current record. Preserve all original requests, partial accepted prefixes, evidence and complete custody/decision archives.
task.completeOutput: The original XML and every deliberate revision; selected official XSD/Schematron files, full validation and SVRL; native model and original literal readings; assigned reviews, explicit sidecar links and saved editions; complete observed weather, selected native analysis inputs, fitted objects, statistics, predictions, plots, logs and actual outcomes where commissioned; all eight turnover tables with their original XML/model/validation; full editable workspace and application archives; installed source and runtime references; original request/history records; the named receiver's useful operating result and maintenance handover. For a commissioned colleague exchange, retain the complete return, reviewed source decisions and validation, received reviews, accepted source revisions and resulting saved edition, plus the complete corrected onward project. Include the complete offline recipient delivery, all authored/unfinished manuscript editions when selected, original returns, native acceptance custody and original request/results; immutable ordered queue editions and all underlying original returns; complete changed-source previews, explicit finding decisions, prior/current XML and full review histories. Deliver the complete installed 82-file application and independently reopened editable project.
task.repeatTrigger: A genuine later audit source or weather edition, an approved source correction, a reviewed model/period/normalization change, a changed turnover selection or a separately agreed customer review. Keep every earlier source revision, saved edition, review, model result and delivery. Reopening or reading a retained result continues its original operation; a changed analytical input is a deliberate new selection. A newly received manuscript, deliberate queue selection or a corrected source requiring review of an earlier finding continues the same original project with explicit current scope.
task.pricedUnit: The original agreement's complete audit-review, energy-analysis or turnover service. Keep the implementation fee, milestones, correction rounds and support allowance in the retained Workshare. If the selected merchant supplies a paid resource, bind its actual advertised resource, request unit, atomic price and whole-task budget independently of the engineering fee.

source.reference: The complete customer-owned BuildingSync XML edition and its provenance; the exact acquired observed-weather file when energy analysis is commissioned; selected retained official validation assets; and any complete original downstream receiving package. Record actual workspace, source, revision, saved edition, analysis, projection and export identities. Record each prepared recipient export, returned ZIP/manuscript edition, native accepted request, queue edition and revision-review archive by its original identity and complete hash.
source.population: The complete selected source documents and retained history, with every native facility/building/system relationship, resource, scenario and time-series row. Analysis selects one explicitly identified stream and full original intervals. Turnover contains the deliberately selected physical assets and supporting records, plus every required table including empty tables. Keep unselected populations visible in the original source; report selected scope and actual missing data explicitly.
source.meaning: Keep original namespaces, XML identities and IDref resolution, unknown extension content, literal scalar values, decimal readings, units and source timestamp text. Shared systems retain every original building association. Total energy, peak demand and monetary cost remain different quantities. Document timezone, weather-station and source-location decisions; the publisher example's address/coordinate conflict is an explicit example limitation. Use a documented calorific conversion for volumetric fuel only when the actual task supplies it. A validation result or model comparison retains its declared scope and does not become a physical inspection finding.
source.changePolicy: Correct actual selected XML fields against their original expected values or deliberately receive a complete replacement as a new revision. Preserve previous originals, official validation and saved editions. Reviews and sidecars identify exact source revisions. Save changed model inputs as a new analysis; an interrupted unchanged input resumes its original analysis ID. Select later project exports as new delivered editions while keeping the original package and receiving history. A colleague return uses proven common source history, explicit baseline/current/returned choices and native validation. Structural changes require a deliberate whole-document choice; exact source-bound reviews are received onto the accepted local revision. Offline proposals preserve their delivered source. Queue editions retain exact original returns and complete acceptance custody without approving them automatically. Revision reassessment explicitly chooses retention on the earlier revision or a complete current review, retaining all previous fields and evidence. A changed native source/review head requires a new deliberate preview and decisions.

receiving.application: The maintained Audit Exchange browser, CLI, typed client and audit-workspaces Merchant provider through the selected Runtime/Applications installation. Use the existing Customer installations desk for the original commercial workorder and acceptance record. A separately selected LDA Audit handover consumes the same whole workspace/application ZIP and supplies immutable editions, source exploration, Search and Brief receiving.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The named engineer opens the selected installed application and original project, locates every agreed source/revision and reviews actual validation and assigned findings. Inspect original energy stream identities, units, weather and any commissioned native model outcomes. Confirm every turnover table and its selected source mapping. Download complete workspace/application archives, receive them independently and reopen the preserved history, selected edition and full files. If LDA is commissioned, receive two genuinely successive full exports from the same source workspace, retain both immutable delivered editions, inspect the selected source and complete Search/Brief output, then reopen the independently received handover. Record actual observations against the original Workshare phase checks. When a colleague exchange is selected, operate its compare, review-draft download/reopen, native plan and complete application controls; inspect each accepted source/review and independently reopen the corrected onward project. For the commissioned recipient arm, personally operate the offline editor, full working-copy save/reopen, installed prepare/stage/preview/apply and exact lost-response recovery. Work the actual ordered-return queue and inspect all its original files. For revision reassessment, read the complete native source changes, explicitly decide each earlier finding and open the full decision/XML archive. Independently receive and reopen the complete application with all preserved histories.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer/source owner controls data-use authority, upstream source corrections, portfolio access and withdrawal. The named engineer owns source/model selection and engineering interpretation. The implementation operator maintains the agreed application and receiving workflow. Original publications and historical findings retain their true source scope; future access follows the selected owner's existing controls and retention terms.
receiving.recovery: Persist each complete mutation envelope, original UUID, expected workspace version and result. Recover a lost response through operation.get before another write. Keep the native analysis lease and original checkpoints; resume unchanged recoverable analyses after restoring the selected R environment. Retain complete original archives and exact manifest identities. Receive through the original archive parser, preserve its receipt, and continue legitimate edits in the newly received working project. Keep current and fixed LDA source editions and frozen Brief material distinct. While a returned-project application remains uncertain, keep its complete ZIP, chosen baselines, decisions and original UUID/version fixed. Recover the original result; retain a newer independent correction draft as its own work. Retain the actual pending later request before replaying earlier preparation. Discover an already accepted native prefix through its original UUIDs; a new reviewed preview follows only a definitive refusal. Queue/revision working copies retain all unfinished text and competing-tab branches. Preserve saved INPUT/source generations and original predecessor leases when continuing the full offline, installed, queue and revision courses.
receiving.maintenance: Name the customer source owner, accountable merchant, audit reviewer, analysis engineer, application host operator, receiving engineer and downstream owner. Retain selected application/dependency versions, R/nmecr installation, schema/profile sources, private configuration references, backups, restore instructions, source cadence, model/stream review and full handover procedure. Keep the original contracted correction/support allowance and ongoing hosting, weather acquisition, inspection and engineering responsibilities explicit.

steps.title: Receive the whole original commercial case
steps.result: Select its actual Workshare commissioning source and matching receiving packet. Retain all phases, owners, effort, price, milestones, source rights and acceptance checks in the existing Installation. Name the actual source, host and receiving roles.

steps.title: Select the customer portfolio and exact source
steps.result: Record complete original XML files, owner/reference, permitted population and exact source identities. Select actual customer buildings and useful outputs. Keep publisher examples explicitly identified when used for application operation.

steps.title: Prepare the installed runtime and native standards
steps.result: Select the maintained audit-exchange source release and existing Runtime installer. Prepare the host Node/Python/lxml environment and the separate pinned R/nmecr environment when analysis is included. Keep the original XSD, Schematron, schema imports and notices.

steps.title: Import and inspect the complete audit
steps.result: Retain the original XML before inspection. Page through native buildings, physical systems, scenarios, resources, source-local references, exact fields and every recorded stream. Review shared memberships, unresolved references and extension content in their original source context.

steps.title: Review validation and deliberate corrections
steps.result: Select the official schema/profiles, retain full diagnostics and SVRL, and assign actual findings. Apply source corrections against expected original values or add a complete replacement revision. Compare the full revisions and keep every previous original. For colleague returns, compare proven common baselines against current and returned XML, review conflicts and structural choices explicitly, validate the entire selected plan and apply it atomically with its original returned archive.

steps.title: Save accountable review and source editions
steps.result: Record review title, owner, due date, state, evidence and note against exact source/revision/entity. Add only explicit downstream sidecars. Freeze the chosen source/reviews/links/analysis state in a saved edition.

steps.title: Prepare exact energy and observed-weather inputs
steps.result: Select one actual building, scenario, resource and Total-energy stream. Preserve literal readings, intervals and units. Acquire complete observed weather and retain original file, station/source, units, timezone, interval and coverage. Review any allocation, conversion, period split or normalization choice.

steps.title: Run and interpret the original native models
steps.result: Run the selected nmecr catalogue with actual interval applicability. Inspect full original fitted models, statistics, reporting predictions, normalization and uncertainty where selected. Retain native failures alongside successful outputs. Resume the same unchanged interrupted analysis through its original lease and checkpoints.

steps.title: Prepare the full eight-table turnover
steps.result: Select physical assets and supporting audit records deliberately. Preview all tables and native field mappings, then save the exact selection. Preserve full XML/model/validation and all eight CSV files, including zero-row tables, for the receiving operator's review.

steps.title: Receive and accept complete colleague manuscripts
steps.result: Prepare a complete offline recipient editor from an actual retained native export. Receive the full original/project manuscript return, inspect the complete current native preview and accept explicit proposals with original request/partial-prefix recovery. Retain whole custody and every authored edition.

steps.title: Work immutable ordered return queues
steps.result: Select actual retained return IDs/hashes, order them and save whole-queue/per-return notes and Review/Defer choices. Preview/apply each useful selected return separately. Export all queue editions, original returns and acceptance custody; retain read-only original-author history on receiving.

steps.title: Reassess findings against a changed native source
steps.result: Preview selected earlier reviews against the actual current XML, complete scalar/reference changes and validation. Explicitly retain each earlier finding with a reason or provide a complete reviewed current record. Apply the full selection atomically and retain exact before/after history, source XML and original decision archive.

steps.title: Export complete project and installed source
steps.result: Save the current or selected-edition review and complete workspace/application ZIP with all original revisions, analyses, files, histories and manifests. Deliver the selected managed Runtime package separately where the receiving host needs the entire Applications/Merchant environment.

steps.title: Receive the useful customer operation independently
steps.result: Receive the complete archive into the named operator's working project, reopen its preserved source and saved edition, inspect full files and perform the agreed useful review. Continue selected asset/LDA receiving from those exact exports; bind explicit original source and record identities. Where contracted, return the colleague's complete edited project to the original author, apply the reviewed selection, then independently receive the complete corrected onward project.

steps.title: Hand over ongoing corrections and maintenance
steps.result: Record actual acceptance in the original Installation, hand over all editable sources and operating instructions, and assign cadence, backups, access renewal, recovery and contracted support. A later source or analytical change keeps its original lineage and selected scope.

inputs: Complete original Workshare commissioning source and matching packet; actual commercial case, all phases/owners/effort, price, milestone and support terms; existing Installation selection when present
Complete original BuildingSync source files with owner, source reference, source-use authority, actual portfolio scope and permitted receiving destinations
Selected installed Audit source release and Runtime, original Python/lxml and any required R/nmecr installation, exact official schema/profile selections and actual host identities
Native workspace/source/revision/edition identifiers; complete source-local identity, field and relationship review; assigned engineering findings and explicit downstream links
Original Total-energy stream and source building/scenario/resource association, native energy units and meter intervals; actual allocation or calorific conversion source when required

Complete observed-weather file with original hash/bytes/reference, station rationale, actual temperature units/timezone/interval and required coverage; selected baseline/reporting/normalization windows
Actual selected model catalogue and native options, reporting/normalization policy, error interpretation and accountable analysis engineer
Deliberate physical-asset and supporting-record turnover selection, all eight required tables and the customer's explicit receiving/mapping requirements
Actual merchant/buyer deployment and any separately approved resource/network/asset/recipient/atomic-price/task-budget/facilitator selections
Named receiving host/operator, complete editable archive destinations, original evidence retention, backup/restore and source/customer access terms
Where LDA is selected, two genuine successive full exports from the same original Audit workspace, the receiving collection/case, current or fixed Search selection and agreed complete Brief handover

Where recipient work is commissioned, the actual complete original author export, all returned ZIP/manuscript editions, named reviewer and retained native acceptance request/custody identities; each queue's explicit ordered return selection and notes

Where source reassessment is commissioned, actual earlier review IDs, selected current source/revision, complete preview and one deliberate retain/update decision per finding, including accountable reason and full current review fields
